title: IngestSummary
description: Final summary NDJSON line emitted by `sqlite-graphrag ingest` after all per-file events. Always the last line on stdout. Since v1.2.3 (GAP-SG-150) this is the SINGLE contract for EVERY mode: `--mode none`, `--mode claude-code` and `--mode codex` all serialise this object. Counters a given mode does not produce are omitted rather than emitted as null. BREAKING for `--mode codex`: `completed`/`failed`/`skipped` are now `files_succeeded`/`files_failed`/`files_skipped`, and `dir`/`pattern`/`recursive` are reported. backend_invoked added in v1.0.84 by ADR-0042.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

summary.description: Sentinel field; always true. Distinguishes this line from per-file events.

pattern.description: Glob pattern used to match files.

files_total.description: Total files matched by the pattern.

files_failed.description: Files that failed processing or persistence.

files_skipped.description: Files skipped (duplicates, invalid names, empty or oversized bodies), plus rows already completed by an earlier run.

entities_total.description: Total entities written across the run. Emitted by the LLM modes; `--mode none` extracts no graph and omits it.

rels_total.description: Total relationships written across the run. Emitted by the LLM modes; `--mode none` omits it.

cost_usd.description: Cumulative LLM cost in USD; stays 0 on an OAuth subscription. Emitted by `--mode claude-code`; `--mode codex` responses carry no cost figure and `--mode none` pays none.

input_tokens_total.description: GAP-SG-150: prompt tokens billed across the run. Emitted only by `--mode codex`.

output_tokens_total.description: GAP-SG-150: completion tokens billed across the run. Emitted only by `--mode codex`.

backend_invoked.description: v1.0.84 (ADR-0042): embedding backend that ran the live embedding across this ingest run (openrouter or none). Omitted when ingest ran without embedding (--skip-embedding-on-failure or backend none).
